name: vantage.nvim
description: A Neovim review and learning workflow with the adjacent Pi agent: ask, request changes, tours and annotations, answered by the agent that edits the code.
author: Nick Pisani

scripts.test:nvim: mkdir -p .nvim-dev/state/nvim && XDG_STATE_HOME=.nvim-dev/state NVIM_LOG_FILE=.nvim-dev/state/nvim/test.log nvim --headless -u nvim/tests/minimal_init.lua -c "lua require('vantage_spec').run()" -c qa
scripts.test: npm run test:ext && npm run test:nvim
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
